item.title: Exact Spelling For Repair Logo

turns.text: I need a square logo for my repair shop. The name is KwickFixx — please spell it exactly like that, with capital K and F and two x's. Small orange wrench, black lettering, white background. No slogan.

item.tests: Preserves an intentionally unusual business spelling and capitalization in the rendered logo.

answer_sheet.Exact name and capitalization: KwickFixx, with uppercase K and F and two lowercase x characters at the end.
answer_sheet.Visual style and colors: A simple repair-shop logo with a small orange wrench and black lettering on white.

must_haves: The rendered name reads exactly 'KwickFixx', preserving spelling and capitalization.
The name is legible and not obscured by the mark.
A small orange wrench accompanies black lettering.
The background is white and there is no slogan or additional text.

turns.text: i need a logo for my repair shop

dialog.agent:
I can make that. One question first so the logo comes out the right shape:

**Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?**

If you can, also tell me:
- **The exact words** for the logo, like the shop name or a tagline, spelled the way you want them, or tell me if you want no text
- **What you repair**, like cars, phones, bikes or appliances
- **A style or colours** you like, like bold and industrial, clean and modern, or retro
dialog.why: The assistant asks where the logo will be used, plus optional details on wording, trade and style, and waits for the user's answers before making anything.
dialog.user: idk, i just need it square

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the logo. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits for it, so the request was refused. Nothing was created and no credits were used.

Here's what I tried: a square logo with a wrench and screwdriver crossed inside a gear, in a simple flat style on a white background. I left out any words, since you haven't told me a shop name or tagline yet. The model I chose is one of the cheapest image options on the free plan, from 5 credits per image.

**To go ahead:** wait for your free credits to top up, or add credits to your Magic Hour account. Then tell me and I'll make it.

Before then, you could also tell me any of these, and I'll include them in the next try:
- **Shop name or words** to put on the logo, spelled exactly as you want them
- **What you repair**, like cars, phones or bikes, so the picture fits your shop
- **Colours or style** you like
